title: Concept: Overly open CORS (python) — review required
description: In python, CORS_ALLOW_ALL_ORIGINS = True accepts origins beyond the application's own, so other sites can read responses that carry the user's session. The remedy is an explicit list of trusted origins (CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS listing), without credentials for wildcards.
applicability: python API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
